title: Retarget content CI to the active Papyrus publication
description: The content repo main now uses native Papyrus markup, but its build check still uses the older Gatsby integration branch and fails on unchanged ai-project-planning.mdx. Replace or supplement that legacy check with the active Anth.us-Papyrus production build. Current cover-only release was verified with the actual Papyrus production build (195 pages), 8 tests, and live image/social-preview checks.
right_now_summary: CI is being retargeted from the old Gatsby check to the active Papyrus production build.
